article.title: China’s Moonshot to Release Breakthrough AI Model for Download
article.summary: Moonshot AI is poised to make its Kimi K3 model available for public download, expanding its reach and influence in the global open software community at a time of growing US concern about Chinese encroachment into the top echelons of AI development.
article.title_zh: 中國 Moonshot 將發佈突破性 AI 模型供下載
article.summary_zh: Moonshot AI 準備推出其 Kimi K3 模型供公眾下載，在美國日益關注中國在 AI 開發頂端的擴展之際，擴大其在全球開源軟體社區中的影響力。

article.title: Samsung’s flagship lineup may grow to 8 phones a year with the Galaxy Z TriFold 2
article.summary: TL;DR A new report claims that Samsung’s second-generation Galaxy Z TriFold could launch alongside the Galaxy Z Fold 9 series next year. The company is also expected to introduce a Galaxy S27 Pro, creating a “4+4” flagship strategy with four Galaxy S phones and four foldables every year. Unlike the first Galaxy Z TriFold, which had a limited production run, Samsung could manufacture the second-generation model in larger numbers. Just days after Samsung unveiled the Galaxy Z Fold 8 , Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra , and Galaxy Z Flip 8 , reports are already emerging about what could be the company’s most ambitious flagship smartphone plans yet. article.title_zh: Samsung 旗艦陣容可能擴展至每年 8 款手機，Galaxy Z TriFold 2 將加入
article.summary_zh: 報導稱 Samsung 的第二代 Galaxy Z TriFold 可能與 Galaxy Z Fold 9 系列同期推出，並推出 Galaxy S27 Pro，實現每年推出四款 Galaxy S 手機和四款摺疊機的「4+4」策略。

article.title: SoftBank’s $40 Billion Loan for OpenAI Stake Gets 21 New Lenders
article.summary: SoftBank Group Corp.’s $40 billion bridge loan for its investment in US tech giant OpenAI has attracted a new group of 21 lenders in a broader syndication phase, according to people familiar with the matter.
article.title_zh: SoftBank 的 400 億美元 OpenAI 股份貸款吸引 21 家新貸款機構
article.summary_zh: SoftBank Group Corp. 為投資美國科技巨頭 OpenAI 而籌集的 400 億美元橋接貸款已在更廣泛的銀團組織階段吸引了 21 家新貸款機構。

article.title: Nvidia in Talks to Back OpenAI Lease of $500 Billion Data Center
article.summary: Nvidia Corp. is in discussions to provide a financing guarantee to help OpenAI lease computing from a US data center project planned for 2028, underscoring how the world’s most valuable company is funneling capital into the infrastructure that drives its business.
article.title_zh: Nvidia 洽談支持 OpenAI 租賃 5,000 億美元數據中心
article.summary_zh: Nvidia Corp. 正在討論提供融資擔保，以幫助 OpenAI 從一個計畫於 2028 年啟動的美國數據中心項目租賃運算資源，凸顯全球最具價值公司如何將資本注入推動其業務發展的基礎設施。

article.title: Stop correcting AI code. Build the system agents need.
article.summary: If software engineers are no longer writing code, what are they doing? That’s the question on millions of minds.  AI tools are now widely used by developers, but fear of layoffs remains a concern. On the other hand, coding is only one part of software engineering. This creates an opportunity for engineers to get closer to the business and to the context of their role’s purpose within their organization and industry. “I like to think in parallels. In 2009, I was like, what if Ops was more like Dev?” wondered Patrick Debois , a member of technical staff at Tessl, coiner of the term DevOps, and founder of the DevOpsDays global event series . article.title_zh: 停止修正 AI 程式碼。建立系統代理所需的架構。
article.summary_zh: 隨著 AI 工具被開發者廣泛使用，軟體工程師的角色正在轉變。雖然編寫程式碼只是軟體工程的一部分，但如何應對 AI 帶來的職業變化成為關鍵議題。

article.title: 5 ways SRE AI agents are set to augment human capabilities
article.summary: In digital operations management, AI agents give organizations a competitive edge by reducing incident volume and accelerating recovery. The potential for transformation is real, but only when agents are deployed against a single targeted use case, rather than simply adding an “AI layer” to existing capabilities. One practical area where enterprise AI agents can reshape traditional workflows is site reliability engineering (SRE), where the standard operating model is reactive and human-centric. This model carries a heavy cost, burdening engineers with repetitive toil that swallows their time and can lead to burnout.  SRE AI agents offer a way to change how site reliability engineers work, turning them from “doers” manually managing operations to “managers
article.title_zh: SRE AI 代理增強人類能力的 5 種方式
article.summary_zh: 在數位營運管理中，AI 代理通過減少事件量和加快恢復速度為組織提供競爭優勢。只有在針對單一目標使用案例部署代理時，轉型潛力才能真正實現，而不是簡單地添加「AI 層」。

article.title: The Solution to the Power Grid's Woes Might Just Be Sitting in Your Driveway
article.summary: More electric vehicles are becoming capable of providing backup power at a time when the US is increasingly in need of more electrons.
